newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union names chief financial officer.

text.p: Grand Union Co on Wednesday said it named Jeffrey Freimark executive vice president and chief financial officer.

Freimark, who will assume his post in early March, is currently executive vice president and chief financial officer for Pueblo International, a retail supermarket chain with operations in Florida and the Caribbean, Grand Union said.
Grand Union in its statement did not say who Freimark was replacing. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
